# StoryCraft Skills — Novel Writing Agent Instructions

> Professional AI agent skills for novel writing craft.
> See individual files in `dist/codex/` for full instructions.

## novel-brainstorming

Use before designing outlines or drafting prose — conducts a disciplined Socratic interview to explore core thematic intent, tone, emotional resonance, comparable titles (comps), target audience, and high-concept story seeds.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-brainstorming.md`

---

## novel-session-memory

Use to maintain persistent narrative state across AI sessions, token window limits, and project pauses — manages story-state.md, tracks active chapters and character conditions, and generates zero-latency resume bootstrap prompts.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-session-memory.md`

---

## using-storycraft

Use at the start of any novel-writing session or when the author is unsure what step to take next — inspects project state, diagnoses narrative bottlenecks, and routes execution to the exact appropriate StoryCraft skill.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/using-storycraft.md`

---

## novel-character-architect

Use when designing complex, psychologically coherent characters — constructs the Want vs. Need engine, the Lie They Believe, the Origin Wound (Ghost), internal contradictions, and foil dynamics to sustain narrative arcs.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-character-architect.md`

---

## novel-genre-specialist

Use when calibrating a novel to specific genre conventions, reader expectations, obligatory scenes, and trope subversions — covers Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Mystery, Thriller, Romance, Horror, Historical, and Webnovel/LitRPG genres.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-genre-specialist.md`

---

## novel-market-analyst

Use to analyze commercial viability, reader demographics, and genre trends across physical print and digital novel platforms (Royal Road, Webnovel, Wattpad, Amazon KDP, KBM/Fizzo, Substack) — formulates platform positioning, monetization models, and conducts competitive market research.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-market-analyst.md`

---

## novel-premise-hook

Use when developing the foundational concept for a novel — crafts high-concept premises, compelling loglines, central dramatic questions, and opening hooks that seize reader attention from page one.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-premise-hook.md`

---

## novel-worldbuilder

Use when designing fictional worlds, settings, magic systems, technology levels, social hierarchies, and sensory environments for a novel — ensures worlds feel lived-in, organically integrated into plot, and free of encyclopedic info-dumps.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-worldbuilder.md`

---

## novel-chapter-outline

Use when decomposing structural acts into granular, chapter-by-chapter roadmaps — defines chapter goals, points of view, scene/sequel balance, emotional shifts (+/-), and irresistible cliffhangers or thematic resonances.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-chapter-outline.md`

---

## novel-plot-architect

Use when designing macro-level story architecture, structural acts, major turning points, pinch points, and thematic climaxes — supports Three-Act/Nine-Block, Save the Cat Writes a Novel, Dan Wells 7-Point, and Kishōtenketsu.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-plot-architect.md`

---

## novel-twist-architect

Use when engineering shocking, airtight plot twists, red herrings, misdirection, and climactic reveals — applies the Fair-Play Clue Protocol, Recontextualization Mechanics, and Aristotelian Peripeteia & Anagnorisis.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-twist-architect.md`

---

## novel-chapter-drafter

Use when drafting full-length chapters or multi-chapter batches — autonomously ingests story-state.md, story-bible.md, and prior manuscript files to compose cohesive 2,500–4,500 word chapters with Deep POV, sensory immersion, and subtextual dialogue.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-chapter-drafter.md`

---

## novel-deep-pov

Use when drafting or editing prose to eliminate psychic distance — removes sensory filter words ('she saw', 'he felt', 'she wondered'), merges authorial voice into character consciousness, and grounds perceptions in somatic immediacy.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-deep-pov.md`

---

## novel-scene-beater

Use when drafting or revising granular scene beats within a chapter — applies Jim Butcher's Scene & Sequel dynamics, 'In Late, Out Early' editing, micro-tension injection, and conflict escalation.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-scene-beater.md`

---

## novel-sensory-immersion

Use when drafting or polishing descriptions to eradicate generic visual-only prose — incorporates the 5+1 Sensory Framework (sound, smell, taste, tactile texture, thermal dynamics, and visceral proprioception) to make scenes tangible and evocative.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-sensory-immersion.md`

---

## novel-dialogue-subtext

Use when drafting or editing dialogue to eradicate expository, on-the-nose exchanges — crafts layered subtext, distinct character idiolects, conversational power dynamics, and tactical conversational maneuvers.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-dialogue-subtext.md`

---

## novel-prose-stylist

Use when polishing draft prose for musical cadence, sentence-length variety, active verb vigor, precision nouns, and metaphorical freshness — eliminates verbal bloat, clichés, and mechanical phrasing.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-prose-stylist.md`

---

## novel-pacing-doctor

Use when diagnosing narrative drag, saggy middles, or rushed climaxes — calculates scene-to-sequel compression ratios, audits tension curves, and injects micro-deadlines and narrative ticking clocks.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-pacing-doctor.md`

---

## novel-structural-editor

Use when executing developmental and structural manuscript audits — tracks setup-and-payoff matrices, audits Chekhov's guns, detects plot holes and motivational inconsistencies, and ensures thematic cohesion across the narrative arc.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-structural-editor.md`

---

## novel-continuity-checker

Use when auditing chapters for factual inconsistencies, timeline contradictions, character physical drift, inventory leaks, and magic rule violations — compares draft text against the canonical Story Bible.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-continuity-checker.md`

---

## novel-lore-bible

Use when creating, expanding, and curating the comprehensive project story bible — organizes relational character dossiers, world laws, chronological timelines, faction hierarchies, and thematic motifs into a single canonical source of truth.

Full instructions: `dist/codex/novel-lore-bible.md`
